NIVA Reference Rivers

Published

August 9, 2022

Overview

Monthly water chemistry samples collected from 2017 to 2022 with targeted rivers switching every other year.

In total, 79 watersheds were sampled all over Norway, of which:

  • 28 rivers were sampled in 2018 & 2020 (12 in Østlandet, 8 in Finnmark, 5 in Vest, 1 in Sorlandet and 1 in Midt-Norge).
  • 28 rivers were sampled in 2019 & 2021 (12 in Midt-Norge, 9 in Sorlandet, 4 in Nord-Norge ytre, and 2 in Vest Norge).
  • 4 rivers were sampled in all years (all in Østlandet).
